# aws-messaging

SQS dead-letter queues and redrive, SNS encryption and subscription lifecycle, EventBridge rule/target wiring - the delivery guarantees the MESSAGING rules measure.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-MSG-001` | high | SQS queue declares no dead-letter redrive policy |
| `AF-MSG-002` | medium | SNS topic declares no KMS encryption |
| `AF-MSG-003` | medium | SNS subscription stuck in PendingConfirmation |
| `AF-MSG-004` | medium | Enabled EventBridge rule has no targets |
